question: From which knot do the three principles originate according to this teaching?
premises: The brahma knot is mentioned as situated
Three items are indicated from there
The teaching is addressed to the beautiful-faced one
inference: The three principles originate from the brahma knot, O beautiful-faced one.
uncertainties: etāṃ trīṇi construction is syntactically unclear
plain_english: Situated at the brahma knot, from here indeed are these three, O beautiful-faced one.
